robustness.basis: 10 phase seeds each of a best case (peak intervals, estimates -15%, 200 m stops, Overhead Railway every 3 min) and a worst case (off-peak intervals, estimates +15%, 450 m stops, no assumed routes 13/43B, no company buses, peak window 30 min earlier, uncertain readings dropped, Overhead Railway through trains only)

trams 11% slower (the tram model's out-of-sample bias against Liverpool's printed times); best case adds Salford Corporation trams on the surveyed track at the median printed MCT headway (their own timetables were not found)
printed times; no alternative readings affect 08:00 (no historical buses: a lower bound)
the project's own variant feeds (tram model faster and slower, headways higher and lower, occasional services)

method.walking: 4.8 km/h, crow-fly x1.3, max 20 min access/egress walk
method.router: RAPTOR, unlimited transfers (1 min boarding penalty after first ride)
method.population: Census 2021 LSOA population-weighted centroids within 30 km

corridor_comparison.definition: LSOA centroids within 800 m of a 1950s tram stop

full_network_comparison.definition: LSOA centroids within 800 m of any 1957 stop (tram or bus)
